scope: Extend generated DBCOLOR OBJECTS allocation transaction evidence across AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 writer versions.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored record generated during each test run
source.profile: One rooted ACAD_COLOR dictionary and one DBCOLOR record with explicit owner, RGB, color method, entry name, and book name.

implementation.method: For each version and encoding, calibrate a complete write, inject std::bad_alloc at every measured callback allocation, require unchanged destination sentinel and caller record, retry on the same codec, compare retry bytes with clean output, and freshly read the typed DBCOLOR record.

validation.directControl: build/tests/libdxfrw_dbcolor_objects_allocation_tests build/dbcolor-scratch: PASS; AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, and AC1032 each cover ASCII 8 and Binary 8 offsets

limitations: Generated DXF allocation rollback, retry, and typed readback evidence only; this does not establish producer-profile breadth or native consumer semantics.
One generated DBCOLOR field profile is tested per version; other payload combinations and independent producer behavior remain open.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
